{{Top|leg}}
'''Docking Bay 16''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] on the [[Commerce Guild trading station]], from which the [[Bpfasshi Dark Jedi leader]] escaped in [[700 BBY]]. His escape was discovered by a [[Unidentified Takara officer|officer]] from the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Takara (ship)|''Takara'']], who told everything to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[T'dai]]. After the officer's report, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Duel on Dagobah (700 BBY)|killed]] the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] in combat on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="Heart of Darkness">{{Tales|16|Heart of Darkness}}</ref>
